event: The Floor 11 door opens and warm, sweet, wet air breathes out at the party.
Solenne takes in a fungal forest lit pale blue, yellow and violet under a 40-meter ceiling.
All six stand still while their senses recalibrate to the breathing biome.
Nadia jokes that it smells like the Tower is trying.
Tomás moves ten meters ahead on the soft, sound-deadening fungal floor.
Tomás reports ceiling heights and sight lines and admits his noise-read is degraded.
Solenne raises the Annotated Staff and activates Arcane Analysis.
Analysis shows the three light colors are a floor mechanic: navigation, Mana warning, territory.
Solenne spots six Sporeback Ramblers forty meters out between two trunk-columns.
Analysis rates the Ramblers Adaptive Tier I with a shared sensory pool and a Spore Cloud DoT.
Solenne realizes the cluster cannot be isolated; it acts as one distributed awareness.
She sends the data through Harmony Conductor with her urgency to fill a gap layered in.
Dayo reads the V-pattern and plans to hit the formation as a formation.
Dayo asks Miriam for regen before contact and Vesper about the spore growth.
Solenne explains the Spore Cloud DoT and that Nature's Veil can clear it; Miriam notes it.
Nadia draws a Chaos Grenade and asks how smart the Ramblers are.
Solenne says they are Tier I Adaptive and will adjust; Nadia says 'Cool cool cool.'
As the party approaches, the Ramblers invert their V and flank left and right.
Dayo hits the center pair with Shield Rush, knocking the lead Rambler back.
The second Rambler circles left into the dead ground to Tomás's left.
The flanking Rambler slips through the gap and circles behind Dayo.
The right-flanking Rambler pushes into the space between Miriam and Vesper.
Dayo holds Iron Stance against the front pair, unaware of the Rambler behind her.
The flanker detonates its spore cap on Dayo's left side, bypassing her armor.
The System applies Spore Cloud to Dayo: 15 Nature damage per round until cleared.
Dayo checks Miriam's position instead of asking if it is serious.
Miriam crosses four meters to Dayo and puts a hand on her shoulder.
Miriam's Nature's Veil clears the Spore Cloud from Dayo.
Dayo's HP drops from 527 to 497 from the DoT before it is cleared.
Tomás shoots three Ramblers through the joint under the spore cap.
Nadia's Chaos Grenade rolls Slow on the rear pair; Dayo finishes the front pair.
Vesper Quick Crafts a Paralysis compound that Solenne puts on an Arcane Bolt.
The bolt locks the Rambler near Miriam; Nadia hits its underside with two knives.
All six Ramblers die in two minutes and twelve seconds.
Solenne notes Miriam spent 45 MP, far more than a Floor 7 fight.
Miriam recalculates her reserves in her clinical notebook.
Solenne writes in her personal notebook what went wrong: the dead ground left of Tomás.
She writes: We need a new shape.
Tomás comes down from his perch, reads the line, and says he knows the shape.
Tomás shows a shape: his anchor eight meters left, Nadia's angle in, Miriam's corridor wider.
The party spends fifteen minutes walking the new shape between the trunk-columns.
Three hours into Floor 11, the new shape holds.
Tomás spots four Ramblers on patrol at thirty meters with Eagle Eye; the party deploys.
A Rambler tries the old gap and meets Tomás's Precision Shot instead.
Dayo finishes it with Shield Rush; the other three fall in forty seconds.
Near the Chamber 4 wall, a large plated shape moves in the dense growth.
Arcane Analysis reads a Level 13 Mycelid Shambler with ~420 HP and a 120+ slam.
Solenne orders Dayo to kite it and Tomás to keep up sustained fire.
Solenne sees Nadia lacks a grenade angle and is about to flag it.
Tomás silently shifts three meters right to open a lane for Nadia.
Dayo sidesteps the Shambler's overhead slam, which craters the floor.
Dayo circles under Iron Stance while Tomás and Solenne hit the plate joints.
Below 100 HP, Nadia's grenade rolls Burn and the Shambler's plates catch fire.
Dayo cracks the central plates with a gauntlet strike and drops the Shambler.
Vesper picks up the Mycelid Cap, notes it is Mana-absorbent, and stores it.
The party pushes on, routing around violet Sporeback territory markers.
Vesper silently checks consumable supply against the MP-spend rate.
The party reaches a glowing rest alcove with a still pool at Chamber 4's north face.
Nadia calls it the most atmospheric place she has ever eaten trail rations; all laugh.
They sit down and the rest node's ambient field begins its work.
Miriam counts HP and MP; her own MP is 320 of 400.
Miriam says she must recalculate her reserve margins and will have estimates tomorrow.
Tomás leaves to scout the next chamber.
Tomás returns after four minutes: corridor runs northeast, no threats in range.
Tomás sits and eats trail rations.
Vesper deploys the Field Forge, getting a 30% rest node crafting bonus.
Vesper crafts two Healing Potions and grenade components for Nadia.
Vesper sets out the last casing and says 'Seven.'
Nadia loads the grenades into her bandolier and calls seven lucky.
Dayo sits against the wall looking at the five tally marks on her bracer.
Solenne opens her notebook to a clean page.
She writes: Floor 11. Adaptive enemies. Shared sensory pools. New shapes required.
She adds that Nadia was right about the smell.
Solenne closes the notebook, then adds: The shape worked. Keep it.
Solenne leans back against the fungal wall and lets the rest node work.
